full_judgment: 10. I have heard the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners and the opposite parties and perused the revisional application along with other materials on record. It appears that the opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff on 6-12-82 filed a suit for a declaration that the property in question is a mortgaged property and to evict the defendants from it and for recovery of khas possession and the said suit was dismissed for default on 25-9-1986 and after 10 years, the plaintiffs again filed a suit on 7-5-1997, with the prayer to declare the suit property as a mortgaged property, for confirmation of possession and for permanent injunction. The Courts below without giving any relief on permanent injunction granted two other reliefs.
